verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence covers Railway cloud agents: putting an agent to sleep stops its processes and compute billing. Nothing documents usage-based billing for general services, or billing that tracks active compute instead of wall-clock time. The docs also say an agent machine keeps running after you disconnect, so idle time is billed unless you put it to sleep. Missing for 10: documented usage-based compute billing for regular services, automatic idle/scale-to-zero billing behavior, pricing docs showing per-active-compute metering, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can pay only for active compute time rather than idle wall-clock time

citations.quote: Sleeping stops its processes and compute billing while retaining files
